definitions.explanation: A sudden, uncontrolled fall from a height, typically used for aircraft crashes or falls from elevated places. Implies a dramatic, often catastrophic descent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{墜落|ついらく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{墜落|ついらく}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They are investigating the cause of the crash.

examples.japanese: ⟦ヘリコプター→ヘリコプター：05117_herikoputaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{山中|さんちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{墜落|ついらく}し、⟦{乗員|じょういん}→乗員：24973_jouin⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A helicopter crashed in the mountains, and all crew members were rescued.

notes:
{墜落|ついらく} means a fall from a great height — used most often for aircraft crashes and serious falls in construction or mountaineering accidents.

USAGE:
- Functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb and as a noun.
- Almost exclusively used for falls from significant heights — not for tripping on the street or dropping a small object.
- Carries a serious, often tragic tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{墜落|ついらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: an airplane crashes
- {墜落|ついらく}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: a crash accident
- {墜落|ついらく}⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧: the crash site
- {墜落|ついらく}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: fall prevention (a standard term in construction safety)
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{墜落|ついらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fall from a high place
- {墜落|ついらく}⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧: death from a fall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落下|らっか}→落下：14051_rakka⟧: falling, dropping (more general; covers any fall, including objects).
- ⟦{転落|てんらく}→転落：19790_tenraku⟧: falling from an edge or ledge (e.g., off a cliff, off a station platform); also used figuratively for falling from grace.
- ⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall (the everyday verb).
